|game_text=[Pilot] 3. May reveal from hand to ▲ Luxury Yacht and deploy both simultaneously. While piloting (or with a female), adds one battle destiny. During battle, may draw destiny. If destiny < twice the number of scoundrels here, reset a participating card's forfeit to 0.
|errata_history=This is the original printed text; the image is the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB8-03-Lando_Calrissian_Unlikely_Hero.png]]). The later errata versions are [[Lando Calrissian, Unlikely Hero (Errata)]] (PC-E1) and [[Lando Calrissian, Unlikely Hero (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2, the current text).
* '''Original''' (this page): text as given in the Virtual Block 8.2 release sheet (official text as of 14 September 2012)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock8_2">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_2.pdf Virtual Block 8.2 release sheet] ("Official text as of September 14, 2012"; the surviving copy was re-made 18 October 2012). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022233130/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_2.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>: “[Pilot] 3. May reveal from hand to ▲ Luxury Yacht and deploy both simultaneously. While piloting (or with a female), adds one battle destiny. During battle, may draw destiny. If destiny < twice the number of scoundrels here, reset a participating card's forfeit to 0.” The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB8-03-Lando_Calrissian_Unlikely_Hero.png]]) prints it.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Lando Calrissian, Unlikely Hero (Errata)]]): The PC website card list (shown there by 12 December 2012 and in the capture of 11 January 2013) rewrote the battle ability (“During battle, may target a card here. Draw destiny. If destiny < twice the number of scoundrels here, target is forfeit = 0.”), still with Luxury Yacht<ref name="cl-1282_14-2012-12-12">Players Committee website card list (VBlock8Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20121212003733/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 2012-12-12] (Internet Archive); the same text in the capture of 11 January 2013 (the card is not in the capture of 21 July 2012, before Virtual Block 8.2)</ref>: “Adds 3 to anything he pilots. May reveal from hand to take Luxury Yacht into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle; and deploy both simultaneously. While piloting (or with a female), adds one battle destiny. During battle, may target a card here. Draw destiny. If destiny < twice the number of scoundrels here, target is forfeit = 0.” (The card list writes the pilot icon and the ▲ out as words.) No published card image shows this text; the image of that page is a CardMaker recreation ([[:File:VB8-03-Lando_Calrissian_Unlikely_Hero-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]]).
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Lando Calrissian, Unlikely Hero (Errata 2)]]): the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013, Light Side p. 10)<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> printed the sheet wording again with “Lady Luck” in place of “Luxury Yacht” (the yacht became Lady Luck): “[Pilot] 3. May reveal from hand to ▲ Lady Luck and deploy both simultaneously. While piloting (or with a female), adds one battle destiny. During battle, may draw destiny. If destiny < twice the number of scoundrels here, reset a participating card's forfeit to 0.” The Master List slip and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB8-L-landocalrissianunlikelyhero-pre.gif]], undated) print it.
